summary: Practise Gemba walks, PDCA coaching and visual management in a five-day Lean leadership course. Explore the outline and intended outcomes.
lede: Lean leadership helps frontline supervisors, team leaders and operations managers guide daily improvement and respond to problems in their processes. The course covers Gemba observation, visual signals and PDCA measures to identify obstacles and follow improvement actions through. It also includes A3 coaching, leader standard work and linking team improvements to operational priorities, with introductory coverage of Toyota Kata and Hoshin Kanri.
audienceIntro: This foundation course suits professionals who guide frontline work, coach improvement or connect team-level performance with operational priorities. It is designed for people responsible for making Lean routines workable in daily operations.
prerequisites: No specific prerequisites required. Basic professional experience recommended.
